newsitem.title: USA: House Speaker Gingrich vows to protect environment.
newsitem.headline: House Speaker Gingrich vows to protect environment.

text.p: House Speaker Newt Gingrich said Wednesday it should be possible to protect the environment without endangering economic growth.
Gingrich made the comments in a speech to House Republicans after they renominated him to be speaker in the next session of Congress, which begins January 7.
Democrats have accused Republicans of trying to weaken environmental protection laws.

"With all of the technological breakthroughs of the information age, with all the opportunities available for problem solving, there is no necessary conflict between a healthy sound environment and a healthy sound economy, between prudent and correct steps to save endangered species, and prudent and correct steps to save our constitutional liberties, and we are committed to doing both," he said.

"We are for endangered species being saved, and we are for American liberties being saved. We're for the right technologies for the environment and the right opportunities for the economy, and yes that takes creativity but that's why we were elected -- to be creative, not just coercive, and we're going to solve both," Gingrich added.
